# org: review and classify issues

Tidy the issue tracker:

```
- add prefix
- add to project
- close unnecessary
```

By May 2022 the tracker had three hundred issues with free-form titles; the ask is a consistent `area: subarea: title` prefix, assignment to projects/milestones, and closing what will never be done.
